description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger Your Strike hits a creature.

Choose one: the target is knocked prone, or one held item of your choice falls to the ground in its space. There is no save and no check; this is the guarantee the feat is named for. A creature three or more sizes larger than you is instead off-guard until the end of your next turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: On a Strike hit, no save at all: target is knocked prone or drops a held item; a much-larger target is off-guard instead. No rule-element key in pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/ applies Prone, off-guard, or a forced item-drop to a different creature, with or without a save -- and this card explicitly claims no save whatsoever, a stronger claim than any real precedent found in this pass.
